name: village-kit
description: A small village that grew, at the foot of a ridge (roadmap G69, G206, S89; docs/subsystems/village.md): two ways found over an authored ground, an old road along the ridge's foot and a way from the west over the ridge's shoulder, meeting at a green with a well; fourteen houses taken up nearest the green first, on a 512 m ground so ground lies beyond the village on every side, tenements of uneven frontage and depth turned to the slope and the sun, one-storey cottages squeezed in between them and onto the green, a plot kept for the church, back lanes behind the built rows; each house on a pad benched into the tile set, the treads and the paths through each gate benched and kept bare and worn by degrees, each plot walled with a gateway at its gate, grass tufts, weeds, shrubs and apple trees scattered after the village so they keep off it, at three in a midsummer afternoon. Its camera path goes in at a door, through the rooms, up the stair and to a window. The heightfield is written first by engine-content terrain-synth (README.md).
